frequency_question: What proportion of announced union strike actions actually commence on or before the stated deadline without last-minute deferrals, court stays, or settlements?
membership_rule: Includes any announced multi-union or single union federation strike call with a hard deadline; excludes general labor unrest without a specific strike date.
coverage_note: 10 named instances covering major organized banking union strike calls over the past decade
known_gaps: Minor regional affiliate strikes are omitted as they do not match the national UFBU scope.
skeleton: Called strikes that survived conciliation up to the 12-day threshold without being called off
multiplier: 6 hits out of 10 named historical strike call instances
validity_reason: Labor laws and union bargaining structures remain stable over medium-term horizons.
